say:1:1620868001:1.text: If the attacks were caused by fluctuations in magical energy or force fields, then nearby villages should have been affected as well. However, the Hypofiends only targeted Hausburg.
say:1:1620868001:1.source_cn: 如果是魔法能量或力场波动的原因导致魔物袭击，大概率也会...

say:2:1620868002:1.text: It looks like there's something here that's attracting them.
say:2:1620868002:1.source_cn: 这样看来，豪斯镇中获取有某种吸引魔物的存在，才导致镇子...

say:3:1620868003:1.text: The two villagers spoke of the recent influx of outsiders. Could they be involved?
say:3:1620868003:1.source_cn: 刚刚那两位镇民说，最近镇上来了不少外来者，会不会和他们...

say:4:1620868004:1.text: It's hard to say. We don't have enough clues yet.
say:4:1620868004:1.source_cn: 还不确定，现在线索还是太少了。

say:6:1620868005:1.text: The feast's about to start. Let's head to the plaza.
say:6:1620868005:1.source_cn: 时间差不多了，我们先去参加庆功宴吧。

say:7:1620868006:1.text: Uh... Nothing should go wrong at the feast, right?
say:7:1620868006:1.source_cn: 欸……庆功宴上，应该不会出什么事吧？

say:8:1620868007:1.text: We just need to stay discreet. Besides, even if a conflict does arise, you can use "Combat" to settle things!
say:8:1620868007:1.source_cn: 别担心，我们谨慎行事就好。而且，就算真的发生矛盾了，你...

choice_prompt:9:1620868007.text: We just need to stay discreet. Besides, even if a conflict does arise, you can use "Combat" to settle things!
choice_prompt:9:1620868007.source_cn: 别担心，我们谨慎行事就好。而且，就算真的发生矛盾了，你还可以用“格斗”对付他们！

say:10:1620868008:1.text: Hmm… of course, violence should only be a last resort. We should try to avoid conflict whenever possible.
say:10:1620868008:1.source_cn: 唔……当然，这是万不得已时的最后手段啦。可以的话，还是...

say:11:1620868010:1.text: The lights are up. Come on, let's go.
say:11:1620868010:1.source_cn: 镇里的灯点起来了，估计庆功宴就快要开始了。走吧，我们出发！

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂的玩法开始变得大胆起来了

say:13:1620868009:1.text: And I can lend out my wooden stick!
say:13:1620868009:1.source_cn: 对哦，我还可以借出我的长棍武器！
